title: Passenger Octocopter VTOL
description: A passenger VTOL study distributing eight motors around a protective ring and central cabin. The architecture explores propulsion redundancy, symmetric lift, occupant packaging, and the structural challenge of connecting a wide rotor frame to a compact fuselage.
